name: io.github.AugustusW/sharedoc-mcp
description: Share agent-generated Markdown as links — GitHub gists today, your own server tomorrow.

environmentVariables.name: SHAREDOC_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Storage backend: 'gist' (secret gists via logged-in gh CLI, default) or 'selfhost' (local SQLite + built-in viewer)

environmentVariables.name: SHAREDOC_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL prefix used in share links (selfhost) — set to your tunnel or reverse-proxy hostname
